notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This patch updates the game to provide you with an item to return the Airship to its original location. A player reached out to me and let me know that they had landed the airship in a place that could no longer be accessed, effectively forcing them to no longer use the airship.

To receive the item, speak with Victor in Dalewind after you have unlocked the Airship. He will give you the Key Item "Airship Beacon", which can be used to summon the Airship back to it's starting location near Dalewind.

I hope everyone is enjoying the game so far!

notes.title: Steam Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
The Steam Achievements Update is now Live!

Due to the changes made, I would recommend a fresh install of Path of Dragoon. The Updates to the NW.JS file, as well as adding the Steamworks SDK and Plugins has added a lot to the file structure of the game.

There are currently 27 Steam Achievements added to the game. Some may activate on your current save file, but if you are passed certain points in the story, you may miss out on some achievements. I would recommend starting a new game in order to complete all achievements.

My next update is planned for Late September/October, and will include an end game dungeon that will challenge you after defeating the Dark Dragon Lord.

I played through the entire game and as far as I can tell, all Achievements should work properly. If you come across any problems with Achievements activating for you, please let me know!

Thanks and Happy Achievement Hunting everyone!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Please switch to the Default Installation if you have not done so yet.

Here are the Patch Notes for this latest update.

-Added Armors that can be purchased in some towns.
-raised the price of Herbs to make powering up a little slower.
-added dialogue to allow the player to save the game after defeating the final boss.
-raised attributes on the bosses and monsters in the final dungeon to increase the difficulty of the final dungeon.
-added Credits to the end of the game.

Let me know on the discussion boards if any issues come up.

Thanks!
